categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of metal soft magnetic powders, metal soft magnetic powder cores, and chip inductors. These products serve as magnetic components used in power electronics equipment for energy conversion across various sectors including photovoltaics, new energy vehicles, data centers, AI, smart driving, energy storage, communication power supplies, variable frequency air conditioning, consumer electronics, power quality improvement, and rail transit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced material technologies such as vacuum melting, atomization (gas and water), high-energy ball milling, and powder metallurgy processes including insulation coating, pressing, annealing, impregnation, and spraying. It has developed proprietary high-pressure molding combined with copper-iron co-firing technology for chip inductors, and maintains a comprehensive metal soft magnetic powder preparation platform integrating material, pre-treatment, and forming technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international enterprises such as ABB, BYD, Gree, Huawei, GoodWe, Inspur, MPS, TDK, Delta, Eaton, Infineon, and ZTE. The company serves industries like renewable energy, new energy vehicles, AI servers, data centers, telecommunications, consumer electronics, and industrial automation, focusing on markets driven by carbon neutrality and AI technology expansion.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant business in Guangdong Province (Shenzhen, Huizhou, Heyuan) and Sichuan Province (Chengdu). It has established subsidiaries and production bases in Hong Kong and Thailand to expand its international footprint and support overseas market growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the magnetic materials supply chain, producing raw metal soft magnetic powders, intermediate powder cores, and finished magnetic components such as chip inductors. It provides integrated solutions covering the entire energy conversion chain from power generation to load end (DC/AC, AC/AC, AC/DC, DC/DC).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on advancing metal soft magnetic powder technology, enhancing powder core and chip inductor performance, and expanding production capacity. It emphasizes innovation in material composition, insulation technology, and forming processes, with ongoing R&D projects targeting low-loss, high-saturation magnetic materials and new product lines like high-performance integrated inductors. The company also invests in automation and digitalization of production lines to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of metal soft magnetic powders, powder cores, and chip inductors. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distribution channels, with a focus on long-term contracts and technical collaboration with key customers to drive product adoption and solution sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a global leader in metal soft magnetic powder cores and a rising competitor in chip inductors, leveraging its technological advantages and comprehensive product portfolio. It competes with international semiconductor and magnetic materials firms, maintaining strong market share through innovation, quality, and strategic partnerships with major industry players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.66 billion, representing a 43.54% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 375.7 million, up 46.90%. The company has shown robust growth driven by expanding sales in core product lines and increased R&D investment, with total assets exceeding RMB 3 billion and equity over RMB 2.3 billion at year-end.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly magnetic materials and components that support high-frequency, high-power density, and miniaturization trends in electronics. Its proprietary technologies enable superior magnetic properties such as high saturation flux density, low loss, and excellent temperature stability, differentiating its products in demanding applications like AI servers, new energy vehicles, and renewable energy systems.
